lines.text: Think in you? Think about you!
Many learners say: I think in you every day.
Better: I think about you every day.
About! I think about you every day.

data.wrong: I think in you every day.
data.right: I think about you every day.

native.tip: En español “pienso en ti”, pero en inglés es “think about”, no “think in.”
native.caption: 🙈 Error común: “I think in you every day.” “Pensar en” alguien se dice “think about”: “I think about you every day.” ¡Escucha a Carlos y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.

en.tip: Learners say “pienso en ti”, but English says “think about you.”
en.caption: Common mistake: “I think in you every day.” “Pensar en” someone is “think about”: “I think about you every day.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
